## About
Atlanta Road Body Shop is a family owned and operated collision shop on Atlanta Road in Smyrna. It was founded by D. A. Moseley, and the Moseley family still runs it today.
Dempsey Moseley, who began working alongside his father at an early age, is our president. Jason Moseley is vice president and Jennifer Moseley Brown is chief financial officer. Our office staff and technicians are trained and certified, and we keep updating that training as collision repair changes.
We want the shop to feel comfortable, supportive and friendly. Stop by for an estimate, no appointment needed, and we'll give you a straight answer about what your car needs.

## Services
- Collision repair: Minor and major collision repairs on all makes and models.
- Expert color matching: Color matching so repaired panels blend in with the rest of your car.
- Aluminum truck repair: We are certified to repair all new aluminum trucks.
- Frame measuring: We check your car's frame with an electronic frame measuring system.
- Computerized 4-wheel alignment: Computerized 4-wheel alignment as part of getting your car driving right.
- Free estimates: Free computerized estimates, no appointment necessary. (Free)
- Rental car service: We can help with a rental car so you're not stuck while your car is in the shop.
- Towing service: If your car can't be driven, ask us about towing it to the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Stop by during business hours and we'll write up a repair estimate at no charge.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We are a direct repair facility for most major insurance companies.

Q: Will you work on my make of car?
A: Yes. We repair all makes and models of vehicles.

Q: How do I find the shop?
A: Take the Windy Hill exit and head west on Windy Hill. Turn right onto Atlanta Road, and we're a short way up on the left.
